what: The held-out set (30 records written after round 4, 40 runs, 188 questions; its own fp32 oracle run): the fp16 and int8mix decoders (S = 64) alone on the Mac GPU, the same gate as the fixture readouts. int8mix's layer set was chosen on the fixture; this is its test.

removed: both transcripts: runs[].call_ms (per-call ms; the timing block keeps the medians)
both transcripts: runs[].npz / hidden_npz / npz_key (lane file names)
both transcripts: runs[].hidden.lowest_positions (each run keeps min_pos_cos, its index and the counts below 0.99 / 0.9 / 0.5)
both transcripts: runs[].questions[].probs_oracle (the oracle's probabilities are in fixtures-clef-flash.json)
both transcripts: oracle.npz_sha256 (sha256 of the lane's per-run oracle npz files)
both transcripts: processes[].npz / npz_sha256 / descriptor (the descriptor is the top-level one: descriptor_same_in_every_process)
trimmed.full_copies: the source files above, in the lane directory $ZOO_WORK_ROOT/_clefflash/ (not in the repository)

fp16_pf64.gate: decoder alone on the Mac GPU (oracle ids, oracle fp32 image_embeds -> fp16, zero-padded to 1024 rows), the fp16 hidden read through the author's fp32 head
fp16_pf64.readout: fresh zero states; a row of T ids runs as ceil(T / 64) calls of 'main' (static S = 64): call k gets ids[64k : 64k + 64] with position_ids 0..64k+63; the last call is padded with <|endoftext|> (248044) and the hidden rows of the padded positions are discarded (causal: they cannot reach a real position). The hidden rows [1, 64, 4096] of every call, concatenated and cut to T, are the backbone's final-norm last_hidden_state [T, 4096] the head reads.

bar.argmax: every question with an oracle top-2 margin above 0.02; near-ties listed apart
bar.max_abs_dp_applies_to: every option of every question, near-ties included
bar.reset: bit-equal hidden rows in every process
bar.mean_of_run_mean_abs_dp_definition: mean over runs of the mean |dp| over all (question, option) entries of the run

environment.runtime: coreai python runtime, AOT h16c GPU .aimodelc, SpecializationOptions.default(), no JIT
environment.head: the author's JointSchemaHead, fp32, CPU (parity_decoder_torch.AuthorHead)
environment.gpu: shared with other sessions, no _GPU_LOCK held (times are contended reference values)

other_gpu_processes.note: process listing removed before publication (4 lines); it showed other sessions' GPU work at the time = the times are contended

fp16_pf64.note: round 5 held-out: 30 records written after round 4 (fixtures/heldout), never used to select anything; fp16 S=64, the ship candidate

int8mix_pf64.gate: decoder alone on the Mac GPU (oracle ids, oracle fp32 image_embeds -> fp16, zero-padded to 1024 rows), the fp16 hidden read through the author's fp32 head

compression.head: none in the graph (the untied lm_head table stays on the host)
